description: Priority levels for specifying light source color rendition. P1 = preferred/highest, P2 = secondary (local measures), P3 = ancillary (sample-specific). Static per the TM-30-20 spec; not a function of the test SPD. Confirmed NOT read by the C++ test suite (which only asserts the static AnnexE::P1/P2/P3 int constants == 1/2/3 in slice_10_sample_test.cpp).
